questions.question: If 3cot²x - 7cosec²x + 7 = 0, then the value of x(0 ≤ x ≤ 90°) is:
questions.solution:

1 + cot²x = cosec²x 

**Calculation:**

⇒ 3cot²x - 7 (1 + cot²x) + 7 = 0

⇒ 3cot²x - 7 - 7 cot²x + 7 = 0

⇒ -4 cot²x + 0 = 0

⇒ 4 cot²x = 0

⇒ Cot x = 0

questions.question:
Study the following graph and answer the question the follows.

Marks scored by five students A, B, C, D and E in three subjects (Maths, English and Physics). Total marks for each subject are 100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8faa1f5b2966eca3791cae55b83286621a1a2011fe80f720a06ec93e0dac4fc8.png] 

What is the percentage marks obtained by E in all three subjects together? (Assuming maximum marks for each subject are 100.)
questions.solution:
**Calculations :**

Marks of E in Maths = 60

Marks of E in English = 50

Marks of E in Physics = 70 

Total marks of E = 60 + 50 + 70 = 180

Percentage marks of E = (Marks obtained/Total marks) × 100

⇒ (180/300) × 100

⇒ 60

**∴**** The Correct choice will be option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Since the maximum marks is 100. We can say marks obtained is the percentage obtained.

Average percentage is 60% as 50, 60 and 70 are in A.P and the number of terms is odd. Then the average will be the middle term which is 60.

**∴ The average is 60%.**

questions.question: Find the area (in cm²) and the diameter (in cm), respectively, of a circle whose circumference is 40π cm?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

The circumference of the circle is 40 π cm

**Formula used:**

Circumference of circle =2.π.r ( where r is the radius)

Area of circle=π r²

Diameter = 2r

**Calculation: **

Let the radius of circle be 'r'

According to the question

Circumference (2π r) = 40π

⇒ r = 20

Diameter of circle = 2r = 40cm

Area of circle = π r² = π × (20 × 20)

⇒ 400π

**∴**** The correct choice will be option 1.**

questions.question: If the difference between two numbers is 5 and the difference between their cubes is 1850, then the difference between their squares is:
questions.solution:
**Given :**

The difference between numbers is 5

The difference between their cubes is 1850

**Formula used :**

(x - y)³ = x³ - y³ - 3xy(x - y)

x³ - y³ = (x - y) (x² + y² + xy)

x² - y² = (x + y) (x - y)

**Calculations**

Let the numbers be x and y

According to the problem

x - y = 5 and x³ - y³ = 1850

Now

⇒ (x - y)³ = x³ - y³ - 3xy(x - y)

⇒ 125 = 1850 - 3xy(5)

⇒ 125 - 1850 = 3xy (5)

⇒ 15xy = 1725

⇒ xy = 115

⇒ x³ - y³ = (x - y) (x² + y² + xy)

⇒ 1850 = (5) (x² + y² + 115)

⇒ x² + y² = 255 ,

Now

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

⇒ 255 + 2 × 115 = 485

x + y = √485

Finally

x² - y² = (x + y) (x - y)

⇒ 5 × √485

⇒ 5√485

**∴**** The correct choice will be option 3.**

questions.question: In General store, an item with an MRP of Rs.35,600 is on the discount counter with a special price of Rs.34,888. What is the percentage of discount given for the item?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

The marked price is Rs 35600

Discounted price Rs. 34,888

**Formula used:**

Marked price - % discount of marked price = Discounted price ( selling price)

**Calculations:**

According to the question

⇒ 35600 - Discount % of 35600 = 34888

⇒ Discount % of 35600 = 712

⇒ Discount = (712/356) = 2%

So discount will be 2%

**The correct choice will be option 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Let the discount percent be x

As per this method 

Marked price (100 - discount percent)/100) = Selling price 

⇒ 35600 × [(100 - x)/100] = 34888 

⇒ 100 - x = 98 

⇒ x = 2 

So the discount will be 2%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Discount = 35600 - 34888 = Rs. 712

Required discount percentage = 712/35600 * 100 = 2%

∴ The correct answer is 2%.

questions.question: The compound interest (in Rs., to the nearest integer) on Rs.8,950 for 2 years at the rate of 9% per annum, compounded annually, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The principle amount is Rs 8950

The interest rate is 9%

The time period is 2 years

**Formula used:**

When the interest rate is compounded per year at r%

Total interest rate = [r + r + (r × r)/100]%

**Calculations:**

Total interest in 2 years = 9 + 9 + (9 × 9)/100 =18.81%

Compound interest on Rs.8950 = 18.81% of 8950 = Rs.1683.45

**∴**** The correct choice will be option 2.**

questions.question: Varun and Syan can do a work in 3 days. Syan and Anil can do it in 4 days, and Anil and Varun can do it in 6 days. How many days will Anil alone take to do the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 Varun and syan can do work in 3 days

Syan and anil in 4 days

Anil and varun can do in 6 days

**Concept used :**

Per day work = total work/days required to complete the total work 

**Calculations:**

Let the total work = LCM of (3,4,6) = 12 units

Varun and syan per day work = 12/3 = 4 units

Syan and anil per day work = 12/4 = 3 units

Anil and varun per day work = 12/6 = 2 units

Adding their per day work

2 × (Varun's, syan's and Anil's) total work = 4 + 3 + 2 = 9 units 

Their total work per day = 4.5 units

Anil per day work = Total work by all - per day work of Syan and Varun

Anil per day work = 4.5 - 4 = 0.5 units

Time required by Anll to complete the work = 12/0.5 

⇒ 24 days 

**∴**** Option 4 is the correct choice.**

questions.question: Two trains start at the same time from two stations and proceed towards each other at speeds of 90 km/h and 70 km/h, respectively. When they meet, it is found that one train has travelled 140 km more than the other. What is the distance (in km) between the two stations?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of trains are respectively 90 km/ hr and 70 km / hr

One train travelled 140 km more than other

**Formula used:**

Distance= Speed × Time

**Calculations :**

Let the time of traveling be ' t ' hour's

Distance travelled by train with speed 90 km/h = 90 × t = 90t 

Distance travelled by train with speed 70 km/h = 70 × t = 70t 

According to the question 

Difference in distance traveled by two train = 140 km

90 × t - 70 × t = 140

⇒ 90t - 70t = 140

⇒ 20t = 140

⇒ t = 7 hours

Distance between stations = 90 × 7 + 70 × 7

⇒ 160 × 7

⇒ 1120 km

**∴**** The correct choice is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**If time is constant then 

Ratio of speed = ratio of distance

So, Ratio of speed = 90 : 70 = 9 : 7

Ratio of Distance = 9 : 7

⇒ (9 - 7) = 2 units = 140 km

⇒ 1 unit = 70 km

Then total distance = (70 × 9) + (70 × 7)

⇒ 630 + 490 = 1120 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1120 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** We know that 

Distance = Time × Speed

That means the distance will be the factor of speed.

Now the relative speed = 90 + 70 = 160 km/hr

Now we will check whether option will be divisible by 160.

Only the second option is the factor of the given speed.

Hence, the distance is 1120 km.

questions.question: 30 people went to a restaurant for a dinner party, 20 of them paid Rs.880 each and each of the rest of them paid Rs.110 more than the average of the total expenses. What was the total expense (in Rs.) for the dinner?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

30 people went to a restaurant for a dinner party, 20 of them paid Rs.880 each and each of the rest of them paid Rs.110 more than the average of the total expenses

**Formula used :**

Average = (Total value of all observation/Number of observation)

**Calculations :**

Let the Average bill per person be ' A ' Rs

Bill paid by 20 people = 20 × 880 = Rs.17600

Total bill paid by other 10 people

⇒ 10(A + 110)

⇒ 10A + 1100

Total bill paid = 17600 + 10A + 1100

⇒ 18700 + 10A

According to question

Average bill (A) = (18700+10A)/30

⇒ 30A = 18700 + 10A

⇒ 20A = 18700

⇒ A = Rs 935

Total bill paid = 30 × A

⇒ 30× 935 

⇒ Rs. 28050

**∴**** The correct choice will be option 3.**
